question: What disciplined recitation establishes the practitioner as the supreme adept while abiding in the vow?
premises: The practitioner abides steadfastly in the prescribed vow.
The practitioner chants three hundred thousand repetitions in this manner.
Such vow-bound recitation characterizes the supreme adept.
inference: Therefore, chanting three hundred thousand repetitions while abiding in the vow establishes the supreme adept.
uncertainties: lakṣatrayam is taken as three hundred thousand recitations, following the common sense of lakṣa.
plain_english: Thus, having chanted three hundred thousand times in this way while abiding in the vow, one is the supreme adept.
